test_derivations: Execution copies remap the wine import to local food and remove the redundant food-to-root-wine import, retaining the complete axiom closure and canonical IRIs. Negative controls add explicit contradictory axioms to a copy. The lightweight schema test projects named Wine/Winery/hasMaker declarations and adds a technical RDF IRI identity property. It is not a full roundtrip of the original ontology.
